mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, user_id, parent_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{content})
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN u.status = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN '탈퇴한 사용자' ELSE u.nickname END
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, AS nickname, c.content, c.created_at FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY COALESCE(c.parent_id, c.id), c.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT post_id FROM comments WHERE id = #{commentId} AND parent_id IS NULL AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
